THGC-M1.description: Time History Global Control - Nonlinear (THGC-M1). A single global-control record (key is always "1"); GEO_NONL_TYPE and INIT_LOAD_TYPE drive the initial-load setup while ITER_PARAM holds the nonlinear iteration/convergence parameters.

GEO_NONL_TYPE.description: Geometric Nonlinearity Type (None:0, Large Displacement:1, P-Delta:2). Hard-validated to 0-2. When 1 or 2, INIT_LOAD_TYPE must be 0.

INIT_LOAD_TYPE.description: Initial Load Type (Perform NL Static Analysis:0, Import Static/Construction-Stage results:1). Hard-validated to 0-1. Must be 0 when GEO_NONL_TYPE is 1 or 2.

INIT_LOAD_LIST.description: Initial load list; each item references an existing load case by name with a scale factor. Only applied when non-empty.

LC_NAME.description: Load case name. Must resolve to an existing Static (ST) or Construction-Stage (CS) load case, else the request is rejected.

SF.description: Scale factor applied to this initial load case.

LC_TYPE.description: Load case type: ST = Static, CS = Construction Stage. Compared case-insensitively; any other value is rejected.

INCREMENT_STEP.description: Increment-step / result-output settings for the initial load case.

OUT_TYPE.description: Result Output Type (Final Step only:0, Step Number Increment for output:1). Hard-validated to 0-1. STEP_INC is meaningful only when OUT_TYPE=1.

STEP_INC.description: Step number increment for output; used when OUT_TYPE=1.

ITER_PARAM.description: Nonlinear iteration and convergence parameters (maps to the analysis BoundaryNL block).

PERMIT_FAIL.description: Permit convergence failure (continue analysis when a step fails to converge).

MAX_ITER.description: Maximum number of iterations per step.

NORM_CTRL.description: Convergence norm control. Provide at least one of DISP/FORCE/ENERGY with OPT_USE=true. If omitted, DISP norm defaults on (0.001) and FORCE/ENERGY off.

VALUE.description: Norm tolerance value; used when OPT_USE=true (defaults to 0.001 if omitted).
Norm tolerance value; used when OPT_USE=true (defaults to 0.001 if omitted).
Norm tolerance value; used when OPT_USE=true (defaults to 0.001 if omitted).

STIFF_UPD_SCHEME.description: Stiffness Update Scheme (Custom:0, Full Newton-Raphson:1, Initial Stiffness:2). Hard-validated to 0-2. ITER_BEF_UPDATE is meaningful only when scheme=0.

ITER_BEF_UPDATE.description: Number of iterations before stiffness update; used when STIFF_UPD_SCHEME=0.

DIVERGENCE_THRESHOLD.description: Divergence threshold (stored as an integer internally).

LINE_SEARCH_OPT.description: Line Search Option (Automatic:0, User-defined:1). Hard-validated to 0-1. The user-defined fields below apply when OPT_USE=true and this is 1.

START_ITER_NO.description: Number of iterations after which line search starts.

MAX_LINE_SEARCH_ITER.description: Maximum number of line search iterations.

IGNORE_ELEM.description: Consider 'Ignore Elements' for the NL analysis initial load.

SEQ_LOAD_TYPE.description: Sequential loading displacement type - apply specified displacement with respect to Undisplaced Position:0 or Displaced Position:1. Hard-validated to 0-1.

PSPRING_SUP.description: Point Spring Support (Apply nonlinear properties:0, Assume as Linear:1). Hard-validated to 0-1.

EL.description: Elastic Link (Apply nonlinear properties:0, Assume as Linear:1). Hard-validated to 0-1.
